question: Is the production-function harness with only the LINE profile API stubbed sufficient for this pure in-process cache invariant, or must the contributor demonstrate it in a live LINE gateway?
rationale: Repository policy requires real-setup proof for external PRs, but obtaining more than 1,024 distinct live LINE users is unusually burdensome and the unchanged external API response is not part of the cache algorithm being fixed.

options.title: Grant Proof Override
options.body: Accept the production-function output and focused regression tests as sufficient for this isolated Map-bound invariant without requiring a live 1,025-user LINE gateway run.

options.title: Require Live Gateway Evidence
options.body: Keep the proof gate until redacted gateway logs or instrumentation show the cache stabilizing at or below 1,024 entries during real LINE profile traffic.

recommendation.title: Grant Proof Override
recommendation.body: Accept the production-function output and focused regression tests as sufficient for this isolated Map-bound invariant without requiring a live 1,025-user LINE gateway run.
